headline: These pensioners will receive 650 hryvnias more as early as August
summary: Some Ukrainian pensioners will receive higher payments as early as August, with an additional 650 hryvnias added to the main amount. The supplement is not provided for everyone.
why: Pension indexation and supplements are fiscal transfers funded from Ukraine's state budget, which is heavily shaped by wartime spending and external financing.
